findings.text: non-blocking: the landed fragment asserts "Eleven granted/ended pairs for one id inside twenty-one minutes" and the manifest repeats it, but the densest twenty-one-minute span for codex-sub-1792696262-181762 in ~/.config/reckon/crew/watch/nova-19e05df6b2e5.events holds twelve transitions and at most six lift-granted rows, so the headline overstates the reproduction roughly twofold.

non-blocking: the log is labelled a base arm over the base tree but its recorded module.__file__ resolves to the head worktree's reckon/crew/budget_lift.py, so it is a run of the head library presented as a base arm; the first importers arm at logs/base-arm-importers.log:4 resolves correctly to the base tree and carries the comparison.

non-blocking: the manifest's test_logs names logs/wcopy-base.log and logs/wcopy-head.log, which do not exist under the run directory; they sit at the scratch root, so the evidence for the cwd-artifact claim is not at the path the record names.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits against base 03de30ff9cee4e059b733ab13fb4234a813a0a06 (0a222bb43 latch plus tests, 8540b14c7 latch restricted to the reset cause, 1eb916cfc evidence fragment); 476 insertions, 3 deletions, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the flipping reading named with recorded rows, an alternating-reading test yielding one lift-ended and one lift-granted with a stamped end, a steady-reading test leaving the lift in force, a base arm red with more than one lift-granted, no added failures in the importing tests, and clean ruff; the nova rows reproduce (83 rows for codex-sub-1792696262-181762, 38 lift-granted / 39 lift-ended) and every arm is recorded, though the fragment's magnitude phrase does not reproduce.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make a budget lift's observed end final so a flipping reading cannot revive it under the same id; reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:570 record_observed_end stamps ended_at/ended_cause on the first read that observes the reset cause and reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:1195 end_cause returns that stamp ahead of every reading.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the head gate at 3 passed EXIT=0, the base arm at 2 failed EXIT=1, a red negative control, and two known neighbour failures, but two of its named test_logs paths do not exist at the run directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/budget_lift.py, reckon/crew/lift_watch.py, tests/test_an_ended_lift_stays_ended.py, the evidence fragment html and a figures directory; the diff's four changed paths all sit inside that set.

justifications.durability: the negative control in logs/negative-control.log reinstates the regression (record_observed_end returning False) and reddens tests/test_an_ended_lift_stays_ended.py:194 (assert 3 == 1) and tests/test_an_ended_lift_stays_ended.py:259 (KeyError ended_at), so the assertions fail under the very defect they guard.
justifications.evidence: the base arm at logs/base-arm.log (2 failed, EXIT=1) and the negative control at logs/negative-control.log (mutant 2 failed, EXIT=1) are recorded and reproduce, but the fragment's headline count is not supported by the stream and two named test_logs paths are absent.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the module idiom of reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:860 _stamp_end and the sweep docstring at reckon/crew/lift_watch.py:104, with no plan label or version in the added names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:570 record_observed_end stamps the observed reset end and both readers latch through it, reckon/crew/lift_watch.py:120 for the producer and reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:692 for the pace path.
justifications.reuse: record_observed_end extends the repository's existing end machinery in reckon/crew/budget_lift.py and feeds the single end_cause ladder rather than forking it, though it records a new ended_at/ended_cause pair beside the existing t_end rather than through _stamp_end.
justifications.scope_discipline: all four changed paths are inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no figure or extra artifact was written.
